**Finding: compliant — no MFN obligation burdening us.**

I reviewed the places any "best terms" language would sit and found none running against Corio:

- **Section 4 (Fees)** and **Exhibit B (Pricing, Revenue Sharing Fees, Payment Terms)** — fixed licence, MarketSite.net access, maintenance and implementation fees plus set revenue-share percentages; no obligation to give Commerce One our most favourable pricing or margins, and no third-party price-matching trigger.
- **Section 2 (Grant of Rights)**, including 2.4 Distribution Licence and 2.9 New Products — future products are priced "as the parties may agree", not by reference to terms we grant others.
- **Section 13 (Shared Resources)** — Commerce One's "standard fees" apply to us; this runs in our favour if anything.
- **Exhibit D (Sales and Marketing Cooperation)** — expressly non-binding, no pricing MFN.
- Targeted searches for "most favored/favorable", "no less favorable", "best price", "lowest", "discount", "preferred", "similar" returned nothing relevant.

Since there is no MFN obliging us to extend Commerce One terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, the preferred playbook position is already met and I proposed no redline.
